reshape_tensor_with_einshape: reshape a JAX ndarray using an einshape equation string to regroup and reorder dimensions
transpose_tensor_with_einshape: transpose a JAX tensor by specifying axis permutation in an einshape equation
broadcast_tensor_with_einshape: broadcast a JAX tensor to a new shape using an einshape equation with index sizes
reshape_with_index_sizes: reshape a JAX tensor with an einshape equation and explicit index size keyword arguments
convert_and_reshape: convert a tensor-like object to a JAX ndarray and reshape it via an einshape equation
